We need to generate a JUnit 4 test file ValuedEnumTest.java that comprehensively tests all methods in ValuedEnum. Since ValuedEnum is abstract, we need a concrete subclass for testing. We'll create an inner static class TestEnum extends ValuedEnum with a few instances.

Methods to test: constructor (via subclass), getValue(), compareTo(Object), toString(), and static getEnum(Class, int). Also need to test behavior when enumClass null -> IllegalArgumentException. Also test compareTo with different values, equality, ordering. Also test that compareTo throws ClassCastException if other not ValuedEnum? Actually compareTo casts to ValuedEnum; if other is not ValuedEnum, will cause ClassCastException. So test that. Also test NullPointerException for null argument.

Also test that toString uses ClassUtils.getShortClassName; we may need to depend on commons-lang library. But we can assert format matches expected: "TestEnum[NAME=VALUE]". Since ClassUtils.getShortClassName returns simple class name without package. So test that.

Also test that getEnum returns correct enum based on value, and null when value not present.

We need to import org.junit.Test, org.junit.Assert.*.

Write test methods:

- testGetValue()
- testCompareTo()
- testCompareToWithDifferentClassThrows()
- testCompareToWithNullThrows()
- testToString()
- testGetEnumValid()
- testGetEnumInvalid()
- testGetEnumNullClassThrows

Also maybe test that compareTo returns correct sign (positive, negative, zero). Use assertEquals.

Implementation details: create static final TestEnum ONE = new TestEnum("ONE", 1); etc.

Need to ensure that Enum.getEnumList works; this uses superclass Enum. That is part of Apache Commons Lang. We assume library is present. But for test we can rely on the Enum class's behavior. The Enum class likely tracks instances via static fields. In our subclass, static final fields will register with Enum base class. So getEnumList will return list of those.

Will need to import org.apache.commons.lang.enums.Enum; but our test file will be in same package? We'll place test in same package org.apache.commons.lang.enums or maybe default. Use same package to access package-private? getEnumList is protected static in Enum? Let's check Apache Enum class. Not given but assume it's public class Enum with static methods. So we can call ValuedEnum.getEnum(TestEnum.class, value). That method is protected static in ValuedEnum, not public. So we cannot call from test outside subclass? Actually protected static methods are accessible within same package or subclass. Our test class can be in same package org.apache.commons.lang.enums to access protected method. We'll place test in same package.

Thus at top: package org.apache.commons.lang.enums;

Now create public class ValuedEnumTest.

Write test methods.

Also test that toString caches iToString - not needed.

Edge Cases: compareTo with subclass instance of same type but different value returns difference as int.

Also test that compareTo with another ValuedEnum subclass (different subclass) but same value? The method casts to ValuedEnum, not checking class, so will work; but spec says should be same type. Not test.

Ok produce final file with markers.
